mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months indicates improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE declines over the past 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 3.0% and remains there for at least 2 months, it signals an aggressive monetary policy response to economic distress, which compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in industrial production over the past 2 months indicates a strengthening real economy, which boosts corporate profits and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE falls and INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession characterized by negative GDP growth and unemployment rate above 5.0%, a decline in the federal funds rate signals an effective monetary policy response that stabilizes the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines in recession regime, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures over the past 3 months indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100.0 (index, 2017=100) for two consecutive months, it signals a severe contraction in the real economy, which triggers a sharp decline in equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and industrial production over the past 2 months indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate prolonged weakness.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST and INDPRO both decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), a rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy that curbs inflation but increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises in high inflation regime, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 5-year rolling window.
